## Lustify v8 API

Lustify v8 is an image generation model by Community, available on the Venice API as `lustify-v8`. It runs privately, with zero data retention.

Lustify v8 is version 8 of the Lustify community SDXL checkpoint, built for uncensored, adult-oriented photorealistic images. It accepts prompts of up to 1,500 characters.

### Lustify v8 API pricing

| Model ID | Variant | Privacy | Price |
|---|---|---|---|
| `lustify-v8` | Generate | Private | $0.01 / image |

### Lustify v8 specifications

| Spec | Value |
|---|---|
| Provider | Community |
| Released | Mar 30, 2026 |
| Privacy | Private |
| Status | Stable |
| Prompt limit | 1,500 characters |

### How to use the Lustify v8 API

Send requests to `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/image/generate` with `"model": "lustify-v8"` and your API key.

```bash
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/image/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "lustify-v8",
    "prompt": "A retro travel poster with the bold headline \"VENICE\" in large condensed serif type, sunset color palette"
  }'
```
